speaker: Dipan Soldier
original_jp: ダレス様だけは未だ王のお側を離れず最期までお供される覚悟だそうだ… <PART> いや まだバルバロッサ王は亡くなられると決まったわけではない <PART> …決まったわけではないが…やはり…もう…
original_en:
Only Dallas remains by the king's side.
He's sworn loyalty to the death. <PART>
---
Not that the king's death is
for certain or anything... <PART>
---
We've got to be honest, though.
Things aren't looking good.

speaker: Dipan Soldier
original_jp: 時間〓御〓置の開発を〓し進めていたのは王の側近中の側近である魔導師 <PART> ―― <PART> ウ〓ルザ様であって バルバロッサ様ではなかったはずだ なのに…！！
original_en:
Those closest to the king were the
ones behind the time machine. <PART>
---
Walther's the one who deserves to be
punished, not King Barbarossa!

speaker: Girl
original_jp: このままじゃ バルバロッサ様が処刑に…！誰か…お願いだから誰か助けて…！！
original_en:
King Barbarossa's going to be executed!
Somebody, please, do something!

speaker: Lady
original_jp: ウ〓ルザ様とガイン様はオーディン様に投〓したそうです… <PART> 三〓者などと〓った結果がこれだなんて…！私達 これからどうなるの…！？
original_en:
Walther and Gyne have pledged their allegiance
to Odin. <PART>
---
We revere them and this is how they
repay us? What will happen to us?

speaker: Dipan Soldier
original_jp: ………………バルバロッサ…様…
original_en: King...Barbarossa...

speaker: Townsperson
original_jp: 処刑〓の方…静かになったな……終わったんだな…
original_en:
Over by the guillotine, it's dead quiet...
It's over...

speaker: Dipan Soldier
original_jp: 昔…ここでアリーシャ様とダレス様がよく〓んでおられた それこそ本当のご兄〓のように… <PART> 王が亡くなりし今 ディパンは滅ぶのだろうこの場所も…いずれ…
original_en:
Princess Alicia and Dallas played here
as children, like brother and sister. <PART>
---
With the king gone, soon Dipan will
disappear. Only ruins will remain...

speaker: Lady
original_jp: 少し前までは 何もかもがいつも通りだったのに…どうして こんな事になってしまったの…？
original_en:
Just yesterday, everything was fine.
How could things have gone so wrong?

speaker: Girl
original_jp: バルバロッサ様…死んじゃったの…？
original_en: King Barbarossa...is dead...

speaker: Merchant
original_jp: どうかご無事で…
original_en: Take care...if you can.

speaker: Merchant
original_jp: どさくさに〓れてディパンに来てみれば大変な事に… <PART> もし戦うおつもりでしたら準備だけはしっかりしていってくださいな
original_en:
I came to Dipan in all the confusion,
and it's chaos here... <PART>
---
If you're planning on fighting,
you'd better equip yourself properly.

speaker: Merchant
original_jp: こんな時にその… 何なんですが…準備だけはしっかりした方が良いかと…
original_en:
In times like these, there's nothing
more important than the right equipment.

speaker: Dipan Soldier
original_jp: 先程…マルベス様の〓と共に王のご〓体も運ばれました…
original_en:
The pallbearers just took the queen's
casket, along with the king's body...

speaker: Dipan Soldier
original_jp: 放っておいてくれ… 助かる気など〓〓無いもう生きていても…何も…
original_en:
Leave me be; I can't help you now.
What's the point in living now?

speaker: Gentleman
original_jp: そうだ… そもそも神に逆らったのが悪いんだ…何もせずにいれば…こんな…
original_en:
It was wrong to oppose the gods. If we
hadn't, it might not have come to this.

speaker: Lady
original_jp: マルベス様もお亡くなりになられたのね…せめて魂は 王とご一緒できると良いのに…
original_en:
Queen Malabeth has passed away as well.
May her soul rest alongside the king's.

speaker: Girl
original_jp: 嫌い… 神様なんて大嫌い…っ！
original_en: I hate them! Curse the gods!

speaker: Townsperson
original_jp: 逆らう者は皆殺し…神も魔物と同じじゃないか！！
original_en:
Killing everyone in their path <PART> ---- <PART>
the gods are no better than monsters!
